1. Overview

FNAF TCG is a 1v1 trading card game based on the Five Nights at Freddy's universe. Each player builds a deck of at least 40 cards and tries to knock out all of the opponent's animatronics.

2. Card Types
Type Description
Endo The internal skeleton of each animatronic. Must be placed in a party slot first. Once the required energy (Wake Threshold) is attached, it can evolve into a Shell.
Shell A fully suited animatronic that evolves over the matching Endo. Retains all energy from the Endo. Each Shell specifies which Endo type is required.
Energy Played from hand to add 1 energy to your Pool. Three types: Remnant, Agony, Phantom Agony.
Item Single-use. Play from hand, apply effect immediately, then discard to the Blob Pile.
Tool Attaches permanently to one animatronic. Stays until removed by a card effect. Provides passive bonuses (e.g., +10 damage, +40 HP, status immunity).
Supporter Single-use with a powerful effect. Only 1 Supporter may be played per turn.
Class Rare card (5% booster drop rate) with an ongoing once-per-turn or once-per-game effect. Max 1 per deck; only 1 active per player at a time.
3. Energy Types
Type Symbol Used by
Remnant ⚡R Classic, Toy, Withered, some Funtime & Rockstar
Agony ⚡A Golden Freddy, Nightmare, Phantom, Shadow, Scrap, some Funtime
Phantom Agony ⚡PA Phantom animatronics; also pays Shadow summon costs
4. Deck Building Rules
  • Deck size: exactly 40 cards (under or over 40 cannot be played).
  • Maximum copies per card: as listed on the card (default: 3).
  • Endos: up to 6 copies per Endo type.
  • Energy cards: up to 12 copies per type.
  • Class cards: max 1 per deck.
  • Ennard (shell) and The Cable Net (item): max 1 copy each.
  • Energy Recharge (item): max 4 copies.
  • Prebuilt decks are always accessible without logging in.
  • Custom decks require a registered account and are restricted to cards you own.
5. Collection & Boosters

Each booster pack costs 10 points and contains 10 cards: 9 regular draws + 1 guaranteed Energy card last. Class cards have a 5% chance per regular draw slot.

Pack Card Pool
Cries of the Past Classic, Toy, Withered, Shadow, Phantom factions
Flames of Agony Nightmare, Jack-O, Funtime, Scrap, Rockstar factions
Trash n' Gang, Mediocre Melodies & Grim Foxy only appear here.
Haunting Future Steel Wool era — Dreadbear, Glitchtrap, Mimic class (M2 Endo, Jackie, Big Top, Nurse Dollie, Party Time Chica, Tiger Rock, The Mimic), Glamrock, Ruined, Classic Variants, Shadow Mangle. Also includes Edwin, Fiona, M1 & David supporters.

Points earned (requires login): +5 pts for playing a match · +5 pts for winning.

6. Game Setup
  1. Each player shuffles their deck and draws 5 cards (Mulligan phase).
  2. Mulligan: Click any card to preview it in the side panel. Click "Mulligan" to shuffle your hand into the deck and draw 5 new cards. You may Mulligan only once.
  3. Setup: If you have Endos in hand, select which one(s) to place in the party (up to 4 slots). Unselected Endos stay in hand. If you have no Endo in hand, the game places the first available Endo from your deck automatically.
  4. Starting player is chosen at random.
7. Party & Bench
  • Each player has 4 party slots. The leftmost occupied slot is the active animatronic.
  • Animatronics in other slots are on standby: they cannot attack but can still be targeted and take damage.
8. Turn Structure
Step Action
1. Draw Draw 1 card from your deck.
2. Energy Play any number of Energy cards from hand to your Pool.
3. Play Play Items, Tools, Supporters, or Class cards (max 1 Supporter per turn).
4. Attack Your active animatronic may use 1 attack per turn, paying energy from the Pool.
5. Abilities Use once-per-turn Abilities (free unless stated otherwise).
6. End Turn Pass to opponent.
Steps 2–5 can be done in any order within your turn. You are not forced to attack.
9. Energy System
Zone Description
Generator A side pool of extra Energy. Drawn from by specific card effects (e.g., Extra Battery, Fazbear Entertainment).
Pool Your active energy reserve. Spend energy from here to pay attack costs. Spent energy goes to the Blob Pile.
Blob Pile Discard pile. KO'd animatronics, used items, supporters, spent energy, and discarded cards all go here. Several effects allow you to recover cards from the Blob.

Wake Threshold: the minimum number of energy units attached to a slot before that animatronic is considered Awake and can attack. An Endo in Standby (below its Wake Threshold) cannot attack, but it can still evolve - Wake Threshold has nothing to do with evolution.

10. Evolution
Standard Evolution
  1. The Endo must have been in the party for at least 1 turn (cannot evolve the turn it was played).
  2. Have the matching Shell card in hand and at least 1 Energy card of the correct type in hand.
  3. Play the Shell from hand → click the compatible Endo slot. The Energy card is consumed automatically to the Blob Pile.
  4. The Endo is sent to the Blob Pile; the Shell takes its place retaining all attached energy.

Note: the Endo does not need to be Awake to evolve. Standby (below Wake Threshold) is only a restriction on attacking, not on evolving.

Exceptions

Phantom Summon (wakeThreshold: 0)

Phantom animatronics require no Endo. Summon them directly using Phantom Agony energy, or for free via Springtrap's ability "Summon Phantoms".

Shadow Summon

Shadow Freddy and RWQFSFASXC are placed by discarding 1 Agony or Phantom Agony from hand (consumed at placement). No Endo required.

Scrap Transformation (Remnant Fragment tool)

Equip Remnant Fragment on one of these animatronics. When KO'd, it immediately transforms into its Scrap version (if in hand or deck):

  • Springtrap → Scraptrap
  • Circus Baby → Scrap Baby
  • Funtime Freddy → Molten Freddy
  • Puppet → Lefty
  • Carnie → Lefty
  • M2 Endo → The Mimic

Springtrap Evolution (Purple Guy tool)

Equip Purple Guy on Spring Bonnie. Enables: evolution into Springtrap (using Agony threshold), free Phantom summons, and discards 1 random opponent hand card per turn.

Glitchtrap Evolution (Purple Guy tool on M2)

Equip Purple Guy on M2 Endo (instead of Spring Bonnie). This enables evolution into Glitchtrap. Without Purple Guy equipped, M2 cannot evolve into Glitchtrap.

M2 Endo — Attack Sync

M2 Endo has a unique passive: whenever a Mimic class Shell goes to the Blob Pile (by KO or other means), its attacks are automatically added to all M2 Endos currently in your party. This is cumulative — the more Mimic Shells in the Blob, the more attacks M2 has available.

Springbonnie's "Unstable Spring"

60%: 70 damage. 40%: Springlock failure - Spring Bonnie is immediately destroyed and sent to the Blob Pile. Remnant Fragment cannot prevent this.

11. Attacks

Each attack lists an energy Cost. Spend that many energy from your Pool to use it. One attack per turn per animatronic.

Type Description
Single Deals damage to exactly 1 enemy.
Multi Deals damage to multiple enemies (count listed; −1 = all).
Defense Reduces incoming damage for the specified number of turns.
Heal Restores HP to 1 or more allied animatronics.
Stall Prevents target(s) from attacking for N turns.
Gamble Random outcome - success/fail chances are listed on the card.
Search Searches the deck for a specific card type.
12. Status Effects
Status Effect Removed by
Burn Applied in stacks. At the start of each affected animatronic's turn: 10 damage per stack. Fazbear Antidote (item); Fireproof Suit (tool - also grants immunity)
Stall Cannot attack for N turns. Security Tape (item); Static Dampener (tool - also grants immunity)
Item Lock Opponent cannot play Item cards for 1 turn. Applied by Funtime Endo's "System Lock" (5 dmg + lock).
Ability Disable Target cannot use Abilities for 1 turn. Applied by Bucket Bob (item).
Plush Trap Next single-target attack made by the trapped animatronic deals 30 damage to itself first (one-time trigger). Applied by Plushtrap's ability. Removed after trigger.
Ice Cream Trap Next attack received by the chosen enemy deals +20 extra damage (one-time). Applied by Circus Baby's ability.
Glamour Boost Next attack from any ally deals +15 extra damage (one-time). Applied by Toy Chica's ability.
Hand Block 1 random card in the opponent's hand is blocked for the rest of the current turn - it cannot be played. Applied by Plush Baby (supporter). Clears at the start of the blocked player's next turn.
13. Abilities
  • Abilities on Shell cards and some Tools are optional effects, separate from attacks.
  • Once per turn abilities can only trigger once during your turn each round.
  • Once per game abilities can only trigger once for the entire match.
  • Abilities are free unless an energy cost is explicitly stated in the description.
  • Abilities are lost when the animatronic carrying them is KO'd.
14. Class Cards

Class cards are rare (5% drop rate per regular booster slot). Max 1 per deck; only 1 active per player at a time. They remain in play for the entire match unless removed.

Damaged but Dangerous Withered Give +15 defense for 1 turn to a Withered ally. 1× / turn
Residual Agony Phantom Discard 1⚡ from Pool to Stall 1 enemy 1 turn. 1× / turn
Total Terror Nightmare 15 damage to all enemies in standby. 1× / turn
Flame of Agony Jack-O Passive: +5 dmg per Burn stack. Discard 1⚡ to give Burn 1 to 1 enemy. 1× / turn
Devastating Shadow Shadow Opponent discards 1⚡ from one of their animatronics. 1× / turn
Scooping Protocol Funtime Discard 1 card from hand and draw 2 from deck. 1× / turn
Remnants Scrap Choose 1 Scrap from Blob Pile; place at full HP in an empty slot. 1× / game

15. Tools
Tool Effect
Freddy Mask Immune to Toy & Withered attacks/effects. Exception: Withered Foxy bypasses this.
Mendo's Endos On equip: +40 to max HP and current HP.
Hat + Microphone +10 damage on all of bearer's attacks.
Guitar Axe Attacks costing ≥3 energy deal +20 extra damage.
Pirate Hook +1 extra turn on any activated defense.
Springlock Device When bearer is KO'd: deals 30 damage to the animatronic that defeated it.
Fireproof Suit Full Burn immunity; removes existing Burn stacks on equip.
Static Dampener Full Stall immunity.
Music Box Once per turn: draw 1 card.
Remnant Fragment Equip on Springtrap / Circus Baby / Funtime Freddy / Puppet / Carnie / M2 Endo → transforms into Scrap version (or The Mimic for M2) when KO'd.
Purple Guy Equip on Spring Bonnie or M2 Endo. On Spring Bonnie: enables Springtrap evolution + free Phantom summons + discards 1 random opponent hand card per turn. On M2 Endo: enables Glitchtrap evolution.
Mr. Can-Do Blocks the next Stall or Burn applied by the opponent to the bearer, then discards itself.
16. Ennard (Special Rule)

Prerequisites: Ennard card in hand + at least 2 evolved Funtime Shells in your party (Endos in remaining slots are OK).

How to summon: Play The Cable Net item. All Funtime Shells in the party are sent to the Blob Pile. Ennard is placed on a slot and inherits all unique attacks and abilities from every Funtime card in the Blob Pile - no duplicate attacks.

Limits: Max 1 Ennard and 1 The Cable Net per deck.

17. Win Conditions
  • You WIN when all of the opponent's party slots are KO'd simultaneously (no animatronics remain in play).
  • If your deck runs out and you must draw, you LOSE on the next required draw.
  • In multiplayer: the last player with animatronics standing wins.
18. Notable Exceptions & Edge Cases
Card / Rule Exception
Phantom animatronics wakeThreshold 0 - place directly from hand, no Endo needed.
Shadow animatronics Consume 1 Agony or Phantom Agony from hand on placement (summon cost, not an energy attach).
Springbonnie "Unstable Spring" 40% fail → Spring Bonnie instantly destroyed. Remnant Fragment cannot save it.
Withered Freddy "Classic Collapse" 50%: 25 dmg to ALL enemies. 50%: nothing.
Helpy 99%: nothing. 1%: 10,000,000,000 damage to 1 random enemy (instant KO).
Rockstar Freddy "Please Deposit 5 Coins" Discards top 5 cards of opponent's deck - not the Blob Pile.
Lefty "Greedy Gnaw" Draws 1 card per enemy hit (max 2 draws total).
Nightmare Fredbear "Final Nightmare" Costs 4 energy → 100 damage.
Shadow Freddy "Repeat Gambling" Repeats only the last failed Gamble (does not stack multiple repeats).
Rockstar Chica (ability) Revives 1 animatronic from Blob Pile at 50% max HP in an empty slot.
Rockstar Endo "Tuning" Searches the deck for a Rockstar Shell; removes it from its position and places it on top of the deck (no shuffle).
Rockstar Endo "Metal Scraping" Gains 1 Remnant energy if the attack KOs the target.
JJ "Switcheroo" Swaps bench positions with an ally for free; both keep HP, energy, and status effects.
Lolbit "% BUFFER" Discard 1⚡ from Lolbit → opponent cannot draw at the start of their next turn.
Funtime Endo "System Lock" 5 damage + opponent cannot use Item cards for 1 turn.
RWQFSFASXC "Shadow Pulse" 15 damage + draw 1 card.
Freddy Mask (tool) Withered Foxy is the only card that bypasses this immunity.
Glitchtrap evolution Requires Purple Guy equipped on M2 Endo before the Shell can be played. Without it, evolution is blocked.
The Mimic transformation Requires Remnant Fragment equipped on M2 Endo. When M2 Endo is KO'd, it transforms into The Mimic instead of being discarded.
Glitchtrap "Corrupt Mind" You (the active player) choose which card to discard from the opponent's hand — it is not random.
M2 Endo attack sync Whenever any Mimic Shell is sent to the Blob Pile, its attacks are automatically added to all M2 Endos in your party. Stacks with each additional Mimic Shell KO'd.
Grimm Foxy Jack-O class despite the Nightmare name; evolves from Nightmare Endo (endo_nm), not a Nightmare-specific endo.
Dreadbear Nightmare class; also evolves directly from Nightmare Endo (endo_nm), not from a named Nightmare shell.
